name: Master of Arson
body:
You have mastered the art of setting things ablaze.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): Once per day, plus one additional time per two pyro levels, when you hit with a pyro torch attack, special torch attack or another pyro ability that has a chance of igniting the target, you may choose to automatically ignite the target, even if you did not roll high enough to do so. For attacks which may ignite multiple targets at once, such as sparking torch, you may automatically ignite more than one target, but each additional target counts toward your maximum daily uses.
